title: The Godfather Part II
events_chronological: In 1901 Corleone, Don Ciccio has Vito Andolini's father and brother killed and sends his men after the nine-year-old boy.
Vito's mother is shot dead bargaining for his life, and the boy is smuggled to America and renamed Vito Corleone at Ellis Island.
In 1917 New York, Vito loses his grocery job when the extortionist Fanucci forces the owner to hire his nephew instead.
Clemenza draws Vito into hiding a cache of guns and then into stealing a rug, beginning their partnership.
Fanucci demands a cut of the young men's take, and Vito persuades Clemenza and Tessio to let him handle it his own way.
During the neighbourhood festa Vito shoots Fanucci dead on his own staircase and quietly assumes his place as the local protector.
Vito builds the Genco Olive Oil company and settles neighbourhood grievances, forcing Signora Colombo's landlord to back down.
In 1925 Vito returns to Sicily and guts the aged Don Ciccio with a knife, closing the vendetta.
In 1941 the family gathers to surprise Vito on his birthday, and Michael announces he has enlisted in the Marines.
At Lake Tahoe in 1958, Michael conducts business through his son's First Communion party while Connie asks leave to marry Merle.
Frank Pentangeli complains that the Rosato brothers, protected by Hyman Roth, are taking his Brooklyn territory.
Gunmen fire into Michael and Kay's bedroom, and Michael concludes the order came from inside his own house.
Michael tells Roth in Miami and Pentangeli in New York that he blames the other, setting the two men against each other.
The Rosatos garrotte Pentangeli in a Brooklyn bar and flee when a policeman walks in, leaving him alive.
In Havana, Michael watches Roth's partners carve up Cuba and has Roth's man Johnny Ola strangled in his hotel room.
Fredo lets slip that he already knew Ola, and Michael kisses him and disowns him as Batista's regime collapses around them.
Home again, Michael learns Kay has lost the baby and that Pentangeli survived and is talking to the FBI.
At the Senate hearing Pentangeli recants his testimony when Michael seats his brother from Sicily in the gallery behind him.
Kay tells Michael the miscarriage was an abortion and that she is leaving; he strikes her and keeps the children.
After their mother's funeral Michael has Roth shot at the airport, Pentangeli persuaded to open his veins, and Fredo shot on the lake.
syuzhet_notes: The film braids two threads. Told-order bullets 1, 2, 6, 7, 10, 11, 12 and 18 belong to Vito's 1901-1925 story and are flashbacks relative to the 1958-59 present occupied by the rest. The final told-order bullet is a further flashback, to Vito's 1941 birthday, placed after the chronologically latest scene in the film so that Michael's isolation is the last image.
fabula_notes: Vito's rise between the killing of Fanucci and the founding of Genco Olive Oil is compressed rather than dramatised, as is the sixteen-year gap between his revenge on Don Ciccio and the 1941 birthday gathering. Roth's authorship of the bedroom shooting is inferred by Michael rather than shown.
